notes: EBIT is proxied by GAAP 'Operating profit' from Lockheed Martin’s consolidated statements of earnings. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/936468/000162828026004195/lmt-20251231.htm))

NWC is constructed as (Total current assets - Total current liabilities) using GAAP balance-sheet totals at each year-end; this includes cash and contract liabilities and includes current maturities of long-term debt, so it is not a pure 'operating NWC' measure. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/936468/000162828026004195/lmt-20251231.htm))

FY2026 revenue and EBIT-margin inputs are anchored to the company’s FY2026 guidance ranges (sales $77.5B-$80.0B; consolidated operating profit $9.435B-$9.685B). Growth and margins after 2026 are model assumptions to converge toward normalized levels (not explicitly guided). ([news.lockheedmartin.com](https://news.lockheedmartin.com/2026-01-29-Lockheed-Martin-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results))

Capex_pct_sales in 2026 is tied to the company’s capex guidance range ($2.5B-$2.8B), converted to a % of midpoint sales. ([news.lockheedmartin.com](https://news.lockheedmartin.com/2026-01-29-Lockheed-Martin-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results))

NOL balance and utilization are left null because the FY2025 10-K HTML text search did not yield a clean, explicit NOL carryforward balance and utilization % suitable for direct extraction into this pipeline. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/936468/000162828026004195/lmt-20251231.htm))

Comps EV/NTM inputs are approximations: EV/NTM Revenue is approximated by EV/Sales and EV/NTM EBITDA is approximated by EV/EBITDA, using StockAnalysis market-data summaries (not explicitly labeled NTM). ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/noc/statistics/))

catalysts: Sustained backlog growth and follow-on contract awards that translate into higher sales run-rates through 2026-2028. ([news.lockheedmartin.com](https://news.lockheedmartin.com/2026-01-29-Lockheed-Martin-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results))

Operating execution against the 2026 consolidated operating profit outlook, including management of reach-forward losses and cost estimation performance. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/936468/000162828026004195/lmt-20251231.htm))

Pension and working-capital cash flow normalization following 2025 pension contribution timing, affecting near-term free cash flow. ([news.lockheedmartin.com](https://news.lockheedmartin.com/2026-01-29-Lockheed-Martin-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results))
company_overview: Global aerospace and defense technology company operating across four segments (Aeronautics, Missiles & Fire Control, Rotary & Mission Systems, Space). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/936468/000162828026004195/lmt-20251231.htm))

Majority of revenue recognized over time on long-term customer contracts using a percentage-of-completion cost-to-cost method (contract accounting complexity is a key modeling driver). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/936468/000162828026004195/lmt-20251231.htm))

2025 results show continued scale with $75.0B total sales and $6.9B free cash flow (after pension contribution) supporting ongoing capacity investments. ([news.lockheedmartin.com](https://news.lockheedmartin.com/2026-01-29-Lockheed-Martin-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results))
current_context: Reported 2025 sales of $75.0B (+6% YoY) and record total backlog of $193.6B at end of 2025. ([news.lockheedmartin.com](https://news.lockheedmartin.com/2026-01-29-Lockheed-Martin-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results))

Issued 2026 outlook: sales of $77.5B to $80.0B and consolidated operating profit of $9.435B to $9.685B; also guided capex $2.5B to $2.8B and free cash flow $6.5B to $6.8B. ([news.lockheedmartin.com](https://news.lockheedmartin.com/2026-01-29-Lockheed-Martin-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results))

Management highlighted investing more than $3.5B during 2025 in production capacity and next-generation technologies. ([news.lockheedmartin.com](https://news.lockheedmartin.com/2026-01-29-Lockheed-Martin-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results))
investment_highlights: Backlog visibility underpins the base-case revenue path; backlog increased to ~$193.6B (end-2025), supporting continued multi-year program execution. ([news.lockheedmartin.com](https://news.lockheedmartin.com/2026-01-29-Lockheed-Martin-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results))

Margin framework anchors off company 2026 consolidated operating profit guidance and fades toward normalized (still-profitable) levels through 2030 rather than assuming step-changes. ([news.lockheedmartin.com](https://news.lockheedmartin.com/2026-01-29-Lockheed-Martin-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results))

Capital intensity is tied to the company’s 2026 capex guide (higher than recent years), while D&A and NWC intensity are modeled using historical ratios as stability constraints. ([news.lockheedmartin.com](https://news.lockheedmartin.com/2026-01-29-Lockheed-Martin-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results))

Working-capital intensity has improved over 2023-2025 (NWC as a share of sales declines), supporting less-than-proportional cash drag in the base case. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/936468/000162828026004195/lmt-20251231.htm))
key_risks: Defense-industry budget uncertainty and government funding/timing risk (sales and profit follow contract award and budget cycles). ([news.lockheedmartin.com](https://news.lockheedmartin.com/2026-01-29-Lockheed-Martin-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results))

Program-level cost growth and classification of risks can drive reach-forward losses and compress operating profit (modeled via prudent margin normalization, but still a swing risk). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/936468/000162828026004195/lmt-20251231.htm))

Interest-rate and pension funding dynamics can materially impact below-the-line items and cash flow even when operating profit trends are stable. ([news.lockheedmartin.com](https://news.lockheedmartin.com/2026-01-29-Lockheed-Martin-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Financial-Results))

presentation.subtitle: DCF inputs & peer-multiple cross-check — Lockheed Martin (LMT)
valuation_summary: Base-case uses FY2025 actuals for revenue, EBIT (operating profit), D&A, capex, and NWC, then uses FY2026 company guidance ranges as the primary anchor before converging assumptions through 2030. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/936468/000162828026004195/lmt-20251231.htm))

Terminal value is computed with a Gordon-growth approach; assumptions (terminal growth and WACC) are set to be economically consistent with long-term inflationary defense growth rather than using an aggressive exit multiple. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/936468/000162828026004195/lmt-20251231.htm))

Peer multiple cross-check uses public market-data forward P/E and EV multiples for a realism check on implied valuation level (with explicit notes that EV/NTM inputs are approximations). ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/noc/statistics/))
